name: Revibe ’26
description: Technical events included paper presentation, a mini hackathon, coding and debugging, technical quiz, Shark Tank × SGC and Prompt Wars. The programme also featured chess, art, mehendi, cooking without fire and other non-technical events.
imageAlt: Students gathered at Revibe ’26, SGC’s national-level technical symposium.

name: India Unbound
description: Speech, debate and art competitions invited students to share perspectives on India’s future, youth leadership, innovation, technology and nation-building.
imageAlt: India Unbound competition event image published by SGC.

name: ExAgent AI
description: A practical introduction to AI agents, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, AI-powered applications and industry use cases, led by software developer Hrithik of Merida Tech Minds.
imageAlt: ExAgent AI workshop image published by SGC.

name: SGC Trainee Recruitment Drive 2026
description: More than 100 first-year students took part in the March 2026 recruitment drive and explored trainee opportunities with SGC.
imageAlt: SGC Trainee Recruitment Drive 2026 event photo published by SGC.

name: Build X AI
description: Around 480 first-year students explored practical AI tools, working in eight collaborative groups of about 60 students each.
imageAlt: Build X AI workshop event photo published by SGC.

name: SGC Trainee Recruitment Drive 2025
description: SGC’s 2025 recruitment drive invited enthusiastic students to apply for trainee opportunities through a structured selection process.
imageAlt: SGC Trainee Recruitment Drive 2025 event photo published by SGC.

name: Critical Thinking Workshop 2025
description: First-year students worked through puzzles, group activities and “Think Out of the Box,” with guest speakers Tejesh Pichandi and Mohammed Zabeer Z.
imageAlt: Students taking part in the Critical Thinking Workshop 2025.

name: Substance Awareness Programme
description: Psychiatrist Dr. E. Gokulan spoke with first-year students about addiction, mental health and making informed choices.
imageAlt: Substance Awareness Programme 2024 event image published by SGC.

name: Student Guidance Cell Workshop 2023
description: A two-day workshop introduced first-year students to web development, Git and GitHub through hands-on learning.
imageAlt: Students attending the Student Guidance Cell Workshop 2023.

name: Git & Web Development Workshop 2023
description: Students began learning web development fundamentals and using Git and GitHub in a practical workshop.
imageAlt: Git and Web Development Workshop 2023 event photo published by SGC.
